items.title: fix(test): prevent worker shard timeouts on loaded hosts (#145770)
items.summary: fix(test): prevent worker shard timeouts on loaded hosts (#145770) Prevent healthy Gateway worker preparation from failing a test-only five-second observation deadline on loaded hosts. Await execution completion and credential readiness while preserving early-settlement errors and unjoined-owner cleanup guards. Extend the existing replay case to cross the former deadline without changing its base-leaf or history assertions. Use two concurrent worktrees for stale-retention reconciliation, preserving the upload barrier, real manifests and Git operations, binary result checks, journals, and released claims. Production code is unchanged. CI run 34679294250, job 103514926295 failed six detached-context cases and timed out the 50-turn reconciliation case; #145349 was blocked on this shard. https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34679294250/job/103514926295 Recorded proof: controlled regression failed before and passed after; the reduced reconciliation case failed the historical retention mutation; the contention suite passed all 13 tests; the full agentic-gateway-core-2 shard passed 255 files and 5,038 tests. Exact-head CI run 34680987053 is green for b3edad90c883960b6dd4b6b2108d6072ef7c851b and was reverified with the native watcher before preparation. https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34680987053 The lead's P1 autoreview is scoped-clean. ClawSweeper found no actionable findings on the approved head; no fixups or skips were needed. Refs #145349, #145379. Follow-up to #145657.
